Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the chat yesterday. I put together a short itinerary we can use for the next two weeks to get streaming + tool-calls + structured JSON outputs validated with your engineering team. Attaching an agenda with milestones and a suggested mutual action plan.

Top asks for the first meeting:
- Confirm primary API endpoints and VPC requirements
- Share sample payloads and the canonical JSON schema for your downstream processing
- Agree on a 2-week acceptance criteria for the real-time PoC

Can you confirm who from CardioTech will join engineering sessions? Kai, feel free to chime in with any immediate concerns.

Thanks,

Thanks, Olga. Putting together the tech checklist now — preliminary notes below. I'll bring working stubs to the kickoff.

Tech checklist (preview):
- Authentication: API key + optional mTLS for Dedicated customers
- Streaming mode: server-sent events vs. gRPC stream decision and fallback plan
- Tool-calling: define call signatures for (1) order_lookup(order_id) and (2) insurance_query(patient_id)
- KV/prefix caching: recommend TTL 30s for high-frequency keys during PoC
- Schema validation: run Ajv against provided canonical JSON schema with an additional Redwood adapter shim

Attachments: schema_v1.json (example schema), sequence_diagram.png (draft flow)

I'll prototype the tool-call stubs to return structured outputs that match the sample CardioTech downstream shape.

- Week 1: streaming + tool-calls enablement against staging (demo on Wed)
- Week 2: acceptance testing and Ops review (client-facing demo on Fri)

Please review and sign the SOW amendment; I've included the DocuSign link below. Note: we added a short clause about log retention and audit logs to match your compliance ask.
